Title: Batman and Robin Vol 2 1

Markdown Content:
****_Batman and Robin_ (Volume 2) #1**** is an issue of the series [_Batman and Robin_ (Volume 2)](https://dc.fandom.com/wiki/Batman_and_Robin_Vol_2 "Batman and Robin Vol 2") with a cover date of [November, 2011](https://dc.fandom.com/wiki/Category:2011,_November "Category:2011, November"). It was published on September 14, 2011.

## Synopsis for "[Born to Kill](https://dc.fandom.com/wiki/Batman_and_Robin:_Born_to_Kill "Batman and Robin: Born to Kill")"

Somewhere in [Moscow](https://dc.fandom.com/wiki/Moscow "Moscow"), the [Batman of Moscow](https://dc.fandom.com/wiki/Batman_Incorporated_(Prime_Earth) "Batman Incorporated (Prime Earth)") takes out a thug armed with an assault rifle. Suddenly, a silenced pistol, seemingly floating in mid-air, shoots the thug in the head. Unseen fists and feet break the Russian Batman's arms and legs, and smash through his metal cowl. For a moment, the assailant becomes visible, sending the Batman into unconsciousness with a device in his hand.

Batman investigates the ruins of the Gyro, chastising Robin for failing to think of the repercussions of allowing men burdened with irradiated fuel to crash their vehicle. He warns that they don't have a license to kill, and that Damian needs to control himself.
